scenario.zh: 你在Erasmus MC筹备一项II期帕金森新药试验，需要制定完整协议和监管提交计划
scenario.en: You're at Erasmus MC preparing a Phase II Parkinson's drug trial and need a full protocol with regulatory submission plan

instruction.zh: 选择整合哪些外部监管情报源
instruction.en: Choose which external regulatory intelligence to integrate

output.zh: 已连接EMA帕金森临床试验指南和欧盟受试者保护要求
output.en: Connected EMA Parkinson's trial guidelines and EU subject protection requirements

output.zh: 已连接FDA与EMA神经系统药物指南，为跨大西洋提交做准备
output.en: Connected FDA and EMA neurological drug guidance, prepared for transatlantic submission

instruction.zh: 选择协议起草的优先考虑点
instruction.en: Choose the priority focus for protocol drafting

output.zh: 生成精简协议，最小化入选标准，建议单中心设计加速伦理审批
output.en: Generated streamlined protocol with minimal inclusion criteria, single-center design for faster ethics approval

output.zh: 生成详尽协议，纳入历史试验的安全监测结构和多层次质控计划
output.en: Generated comprehensive protocol incorporating safety monitoring structures and multi-tier QC plan from historical trials

output.zh: 访视频率较同类试验增加，建议将6次现场访视减至4次，增加远程评估
output.en: Visit frequency higher than similar trials; recommend reducing 6 in-person visits to 4, adding remote assessments

output.zh: 主要终点12周评估与EMA建议的24周不一致，可能影响欧盟审批
output.en: Primary endpoint at 12 weeks inconsistent with EMA-recommended 24 weeks, may affect EU approval

instruction.zh: 选择优先提交的监管机构
instruction.en: Choose priority regulatory authority for submission

output.zh: 生成CCMO格式的伦理提交包，包含荷兰语受试者信息和当地保险要求
output.en: Generated CCMO-format ethics submission with Dutch subject information and local insurance requirements

output.zh: 生成EMA科学建议申请文件，重点说明II期设计理由和III期路径
output.en: Generated EMA scientific advice application explaining Phase II design rationale and Phase III pathway

takeaway.zh: 协议草案已就绪，AI审查器识别关键监管不一致，可下载完整提交文档
takeaway.en: Protocol draft ready, AI reviewer identified key regulatory misalignments, full submission docs available for download

initial.zh: II期帕金森新药随机对照试验，主要终点为UPDRS-III评分变化，120例受试者，12周随访
initial.en: Phase II RCT for Parkinson's drug, primary endpoint UPDRS-III change, 120 subjects, 12-week follow-up
